Sandbox_EC_XpModifier_tooltip: Experience multiplier for playing music. 1.0 is normal gain.
Sandbox_EC_CanPlayWhileWalking_tooltip: If enabled, portable instruments can be played while walking.
Sandbox_EC_SheetMusicConsumed_tooltip: If enabled, sheet music is used up when a song is learned from it.
Sandbox_EC_GroupDistanceLeader_tooltip: How many tiles group members may stray from the group leader, while waiting and while playing. Also how close a session must be to appear joinable in the Songbook.
Sandbox_EC_ListenerRadius_tooltip: How many tiles away live music still soothes listeners.
Sandbox_EC_HappinessModifier_tooltip: Unhappiness reduced per minute of listening to live music, scaled by day length. 0 disables.
Sandbox_EC_BoredomModifier_tooltip: Boredom reduced per minute of listening to live music, scaled by day length. 0 disables.
Sandbox_EC_StressModifier_tooltip: Stress reduced per minute of listening to live music, scaled by day length. Stress runs 0-1, so small values are meaningful. 0 disables.
Sandbox_EC_PanicModifier_tooltip: Panic reduced per minute of listening to live music, scaled by day length. 0 disables.
Sandbox_EC_LureModifier_tooltip: Multiplier on how far playing music carries to zombie ears. Louder instruments carry further. 1.0 reaches about 30 tiles on an acoustic guitar; 0 disables.
Sandbox_EC_WorldInstruments_tooltip: If enabled, pianos standing in the world can be played where they stand.
